text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to learn how to make great coffee, Satono Diamond gets Manhattan Cafe to agree to teach her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've really been looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Please don't mention it. Now, let's make some delicious coffee.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The flavor of coffee differs depending on where the beans are grown. The type of bean and climate are both highly influential factors.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Finding the variety of beans you prefer is a delight in its own… Please choose which ones you would like to try…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There are so many to choose from! I have no idea which I'd like best.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In that case… you may wish to create a coffee blend. Your very own exclusive cup of coffee—it's like embarking on an uncharted frontier…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Why, that sounds positively wonderful! I'll challenge myself to create a blend!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: How about these ones from Honduras with a chocolate aroma… And these passion fruit-flavored ones too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's ten kinds of beans you've chosen… I think you ought to stop there…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …What? You think she might create some kind of new flavor? I suppose that's true… Still…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll add this one too… and this one!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Time to try my own original blend! ♪

text_block_list.name: Dia & Cafe
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Gack… It's like a maelstrom of bitterness and sourness. I can't say that it tastes very good…
choice_data_list: Let's chalk this up as a failure…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …The more beans you add, the more complex the flavor becomes. I think the different beans you chose were fighting for supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see… Hmm, then in order to ensure the different flavors don't clash, I need…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! You have some! This should help act as a mediator between the flavors!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! A field full of vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: When cooking vegetables, you mix a whole bunch together and stir-fry them or boil them in a big pot, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There are even teas made from roasting vegetables, so I thought that maybe it could help create harmony between the coffee flavors!
choice_data_list: I'm not sure that's such a good idea…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …I agree with Satono.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I never would have even thought to defy the conventional wisdom surrounding coffee…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll create some fascinating coffee… And my friend seems to agree.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I think so too! I can't even imagine what this will end up like.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But that's all the more reason to take on this challenge… Even if it doesn't end up tasting good!
choice_data_list: How about learning the basics first?
Keep trying until you find success!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's a good suggestion… I should start by building a solid foundation of knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll embark on my blending escapade only once I have the basics down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now to pour in the hot water… And it's done! Oh, but if I were to add in these beans too…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um, I think you should stick to the recipe…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're right! I need to do this properly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suppressing her curiosity, Satono Diamond successfully brews some delicious coffee!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course! I hope you're looking forward to trying it!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I see you've completed your… vegetable coffee. With spinach and bell peppers… the coffee is a deep green.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It practically smells green too… W-well, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Cafe
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This… doesn't taste very good at all! Aha, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You're right about that… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The taste may leave much to be desired, but Satono Diamond's coffee certainly brings smiles to their faces!
